reviews.t: Not the same masks I ordered in the past
reviews.x: I bought several packages of these masks over the past year and they very my favorite masks to wear. Light and breathable. I just ordered two more packages and was severely disappointed. They are now thick and are much larger. It is clear that they are more cheaply made now. Very disappointing.

While the description on the site reflects reusable, the mask packaging reflects disposable.  I feel the information is inaccurate and thus the product is not what was described.  The description also reflected mixed colors, yet I received only one color of masks.

Just got these yesterday and my kids worse them to school and they loved them. They are much thinner than the homemade ones they had been wearing so a lot more breathable. It is a super simple design and not sure how durable they will be or how long they’ll last but they were the cheapest ones I could find since my kids misplace their masks all the time they’ll probably lose them before they wear them out. My 10 year old loves hers even though the ear loops are too big (Since they are made for a

These masks are advertised as reusable and washable.  Instructions are all written in Chinese, with exception of the title “Mask” and disposable mask.  Disposable is not the same designation as reusable.  Misleading, but what was I expecting for $7.99.  Lesson learned!

reviews.t: Not for COVID prevention. Thin and WILL allow virus particles through material.
reviews.x: Not for COVID prevention. Thin and WILL allow virus particles through material. That should be clear for everyone buying this. It says to be used for dust and big debris particles like cutting grass. Don't use it as a safety mask for COVID. Biggest complaint is how tiny it is. I have a really small head and I couldn't even fit in these. Child size masks and paper thin material....horrible mask. You get what you pay for if you want to be a cheap as*

I purchased these masks thinking they would be sturdy and of good quality. However, the material is very cheap and the actual packaging for the individual mask says that they are disposable and for one time use only. Although the description on the overall package from the seller on Amazon says "reusable". I think whatever the original individual package says is correct because quality is so bad that they could be disposable after a single use.

They look how they do in the stock photos but if you blow out the mask you can kinda feel it on the outside if you put your hand in front of your face. You can wear two to make it as thick as a face mask of reasonable length, which isn't uncomfortable it feels like wearing one, but they do feel cheaply made. Passable however but you can probably spend $10 or a little more on one good mask instead of a couple.

reviews.t: These were great for a year - recent package they have changed the thickness!
reviews.x: So just like another recent reviewer, I had been ordering these over the past year and they were fantastic. Thin and comfortable and a great price. Well this recent package I received they are totally a different thickness.  It’s like it’s two of the masks layered together. I am hoping they were just a defect and if I order them again (which I plan to) they will be the correct ones.

Not sure why the packaging says disposable.. seems a little misleading. When I took them out the package they looked like some unfinished cut out piece of fabric.. I would imagine you could wash the spandex like material but these are extremely thin so maybe only hand wash.  They are very breathable and comfortable for me.

If you’re okay with them being thick and unbreathable then you’ll like them.  Also, kind of awkward with the seam going vertically... does it go outside or inside??  Overall, they’re not that bad but they’re not my personal preference.  It’s a good value for the money since you get 5 or 6 in the package.

Outer main package was open and one of the masks inside was also opened. However, I did discover one possible good thing out of this... I ordered medium size masks and I can tell that they are entirely too small. Medium is designed more for children in my opinion. Large would be a better fit for me.

Masks are way too thin and do not provide proper protection for covid.  The test for masks is whether you can blow out a lit match. I tried to the mask on and was able to blow out the match. This mask failed and should not be used for covid protection.

I like them because they’re pretty basic however, with a little heavy breathing you start to build up your hot breath water in the mask so it’s wet touching your face. Kinda disgusting. I probably would buy a different brand next time.

I work as a Massage Therapist where I have to wear a mask for 11 hour days. This is the most breathable mask I have found so far! Thank you so much! BTW it's washerable and dryable no matter what the other reviews said before.

These are the most comfortable and breathable face masks I’ve used so far. They’ve held up all but one which the ear loop started to shred, probably due to the washer. I will be purchasing more, thank you!
These are paper thin disposable masks... breath comes right through. Stretchy mess is good and they are comfortable but at the same time pretty useless. Wrong description, quite disappointed.
got these so that I can stop using disposable masks and also I can heat press my own designs onto these masks and they work just fine. light weight material, very comfortable and breathable
It’s really good for people with glasses I don’t get them to fog, the only thing I would say I don’t like it’s the edges that scratch a bit but if you have the right size they don’t bother

reviews.t: Sleek and slim fit but moves around alot
reviews.x: Nice mask but not for talking or moving around. Wore mine on Saturday and constantly had to readjust and shift it upwards and downwards on my mouth nose and chin. May return.
I ordered these once and loved them. Placed a reorder and they came with a double layer. Not what I ordered the first time. I threw them in the trash !!
Reason this item was chosen out of all offerings is because it was described as reusable yet when product was received it says disposable
I’m a teacher and am constantly in the move. This mask is easier to breathe through and project my voice. Comfy to wear and washes nice.
It’s thinner than some other masks, which I like. They fit well. They don’t push up into my eyeballs like some others. They work great.

reviews.t: BEWARE  NOT WHAT IS STATED  and TOOK  3  WEEKS  TO  ARRIVE
reviews.x: Ordered several months ago and was pleased.  ordered  again 11-28  and just received today 12-18  NOT  EVEN  THE  SAME  MASK  !!!!

reviews.t: Very thin, in a good way
reviews.x: If you have to wear them, these are the ones you should get.  Super lightweight.  I can breathe through them most of the time.

claims.text: Several reviewers find the masks thin and breathable, which some consider comfortable for long wear.
Some reviewers report the masks are too thin to provide protection, including for COVID.
Multiple reviewers say the packaging labels the masks disposable, contradicting the reusable description.
Some long-time buyers report a recent change to thicker, larger, or cheaper-feeling masks.
A few reviewers mention sizing or fit problems, including masks being too small.
